title: Stitch & Salvage — Owner Compact (Apr 2026)
content:
Purpose: quick one-off compact inventory for small salvage tasks discovered during the weekend surge. This is intentionally lightweight — a single-pane tracker for cross-functional owners to grab small fixes, temporary mitigations, or follow-ups that don’t need full RFCs.

How to use: each row is one discrete action. Owners should update status and ETA in-line. If an item expands beyond a 2-3 hour fix, flag it and we’ll create a ticket. Link back to the Confluence or Jira item where relevant (column: link).

Context: surge on 2026-04-04 caused multiple fallback trips across regions. Ops + Platform did triage; these are residuals.

Table (columns: id | item | owner | priority | status | ETA | notes)
1 | endpoint-throttle-fallback-rule | Priya Nair | P1 | in_progress | 2026-04-10 | temporary rule still active in us-west; clean-up script ready, waiting deploy window
2 | dedicated-burst-quota-request | Marcus Li | P2 | open | 2026-04-12 | request submitted to cloud sales; escalate if no answer by 4/11
3 | fallback-routing-sanity-check | Elena Gomez | P1 | in_progress | 2026-04-09 | running smoke across regions, sampling shows one mismatch in eu-central
4 | telemetry-missing-span-fix | Raj Patel | P2 | blocked | 2026-04-13 | blocked on schema update (see JIRA-OPS-8923)
5 | canary-rollout-rollback-note | Tomás Rivera | P3 | done | 2026-04-07 | rollback executed and logged; follow-up doc half-done
6 | kv-cache-warmup-script | Samantha Ortiz | P2 | open | 2026-04-11 | lightweight script exists in repo, needs tag and playground run
7 | stale-api-keys-audit | Priya Nair | P3 | open | 2026-04-20 | low urgency; nice-to-have before next release
8 | regional-fallback-contact-list | Elena Gomez | P1 | in_progress | 2026-04-10 | adding APAC on-call; have phone numbers for US/EU already
9 | embeddings-cost-sample-report | Marcus Li | P2 | open | 2026-04-15 | generate 7-day sample and push to product-ops slack
10 | quick-doc-for-customer-ask | Raj Patel | P1 | in_progress | 2026-04-09 | customer asked for TTL behavior detail; summarizing current SLOs
11 | private-deploy-onboarding-note | Tomás Rivera | P3 | open | 2026-04-16 | capture gaps in onboarding checklist found during deploy
12 | small-security-lint-fixes | Samantha Ortiz | P2 | in_progress | 2026-04-12 | two low-risk lints; pre-commit updated

Quick snapshot (as of last_modified):
- total items: 12
- P1s: 4 (1 done, 2 in_progress, 1 open)
- blocked: 1
- done: 1

Immediate asks / actions:
- Priya: push clean-up script through the 10:00 deploy window tomorrow; call out any DB-impact.
- Elena: finish regional contact list and DM ops-oncall with APAC numbers by EOD 4/9.
- Raj + Marcus: align on telemetry schema update; if blocked past 4/11 escalate to infra lead.

Notes to self / TODOs:
- If any item becomes longer than a day of work, create a proper Jira ticket and move this row to "linked" with the ticket id.
- Keep this doc intentionally transient — snapshot once items are done and then archive.
- Follow up: schedule 15-min quick sync Monday 4/12 to confirm closed/handed-off.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we want automated expiry on temporary throttle rules (yes/no)? (preface: prefer yes, add 1-week TTL)
- Who is primary for cloud quota escalations when sales is unresponsive after 48h? Suggest: Marcus -> infra-ops escalation matrix.

Slack refs: #ops-weekend, #platform-quick, thread: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C01234567
Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1472 (surge postmortem)

Revision history:
- 2026-04-06: initial seed (Samantha)
- 2026-04-07: added canary rollback row (Tomás)
- 2026-04-09: telemetry row marked blocked and contact list updated (Elena)

If you take an item: update status and ETA, add a short note line (1-2 sentences) and ping @product-ops.
